title: Coordinate air-quality forecast
scenario: Read an optional overseas forecast through server1. The HTTP example used an isolated gateway and synthetic OpenWeather data for Montevideo.

steps.title: Read the forecast at the viewed location
steps.instruction: Load the ordinary coordinate weather. If it advertises airForecastAvailable, request the same coordinates with /air-forecast after the coordinate. Read the source, retrieval time and UTC-valid rows. Format the times in the viewed location's time zone.
steps.caption: Sanitized local HTTP response. The particulate values are in µg/m³, ozone is in ppm, and owm is OpenWeather's own index.
steps.expected: A usable response contains attributed forecast rows and sends Cache-Control no-store. Treat available false as an absent forecast and keep the normal weather and air observation.
